name: Cantabil Retail India Ltd
title: Cantabil Retail India Ltd - 533267 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Cantabil is a debt-free, self-funded men's apparel retailer; FY26 EBITDA margin 31% and gross margin ~60%, with 91 stores opened and 725 stores targeted in FY27, but no capacity-discipline signal and no price-hike plan beyond cost pass-through.

capex.quote: capex, per square feet, we think will go down in this year because the new fixture design has been adopted with a lesser cost

triggers.label: Inventory days 123 → 109 → 105 WC days
triggers.quote: Our working capital was approximately 115 days. This year, it came down to 105 days.

triggers.label: FY27 targets 725 stores, Rs1,000 cr online
triggers.quote: FY27 target is online, INR1,000 crores of revenue and 725 across the number of stores.

triggers.label: Gross margin ~60% sustained target
triggers.quote: The margin, what we are targeting on a long-term basis is approximately 60%.
